query:
SELECT 
  saleDate,
  COUNT(*) as quantidade,
  SUM(finalAmount) as valor_total
FROM sales 
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY' 
AND saleDate = '2025-12-24'
GROUP BY saleDate;
